why: Each value was forecast by a run initialised at least 48 hours before its valid hour. Every hour of a target day therefore comes from a run initialised before the 20:00 IST issue time of the previous day. This is older than the forecast an operator would have had, so it handicaps the weather features rather than flattering them.
